Jwt._comment: No key here on purpose — it was previously committed inline, which defeats the point of 'never commit secrets'. Run: dotnet user-secrets set "Jwt:Key" "<random 64+ char value>" --project backend/ArkCloud.API. Production sources this from Azure Key Vault instead (see Program.cs and README).

RateLimiting._comment: Loosened for local dev / integration tests, which share one 'unknown' IP partition under TestServer. Production relies on appsettings.json's strict 5-per-60s default.
